I0.fault_domain_notes: Same executable bytes and observation wrapper; no engine fault separation.

I1.fault_domain_notes: Separate checkouts and binaries, but E3 retains the E1 Rust interpreter architecture and much code lineage.

runtime_backend.paper_summary: PARTIAL (guest L machine; shared Rust host)

I2.fault_domain_notes: E2 guest evaluator has its own tokenizer/reader/normalizer/machine source, but executes inside a Rust DSL L host and is bundled by the bundle Rust product runner.
I2.level: distinct evaluator/frontend source; shared Rust host

I3.fault_domain_notes: Runtime backend and toolchain are separated; source, parser, semantic choices, specification, machine, operator, and organization remain shared.
I3.level: distinct runtime backend/toolchain; shared transliterated source/semantics

Distinct.definition: reviewed evidence establishes separation for this axis; high-authority provenance and a valid evidence_ref are still required

Partial.definition: some components differ but the relevant domain is not fully separated

Shared.definition: the compared paths retain the same relevant implementation or fault domain

Unknown.definition: the available evidence is insufficient to classify the axis as distinct
